alt.en: Honey-toned timber bench with armrests and a slatted seat, in front of a brick wall in a tiled courtyard

caption.tr: Yalın çizgili bank, geniş sırt tahtaları ve düz kollarıyla avlunun bir köşesine yerleştirilmiş.
caption.en: A simple bench with wide back boards and straight armrests, placed in a corner of the courtyard.
